verdict.rationale: Trello documents a Power-Up to "View work from Jira in a Trello list," and the marketing describes Power-Ups and an app directory for linking other tools. That gives a path to bring work from one other PM tool into a Trello view. However, the evidence never describes an aggregated view of the engineer's own assigned tasks across several PM tools, and the Inbox only captures items from email and Slack. Missing for 10: evidenced integrations with PM tools beyond Jira, a unified 'my assigned tasks' view spanning multiple tools, assignee-based filtering of imported work, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
